record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the uniform recent-four-state mean with a causal exponentially weighted mean over those same four states, using weights 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125 from newest to oldest and normalizing over observed positions. Retain the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend. This may reduce stale-interest interference while preserving short-term context. Keep padded-slot positions, truncation, backbone, features, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; synchronize readout metadata and predictor writer.
